description: pkey-proof/1 (WIRE-CONTRACT-V5 section 12.11.1 and 15.8): an Ed25519 signature by the device's signing key over the six lines pkey-proof/1, purpose, product slug, X-PKey-Device, value and token hash (or -), joined by LF with no trailing newline. A field that is empty or holds a byte outside 0x21..0x7e breaks the line format and makes the proof invalid. The signature is checked strictly (V5 1.1): canonical base64url of 64 bytes, S < L, R and the key neither of small order nor non-canonical. Purpose keys also needs a value of signKey.agreeKey.issuedAt naming the presenting signKey, a valid agreeKey (canonical X25519 spelling, not low-order) and |issuedAt - now| <= skewSeconds, and a token hash of -. A runner answers true or false only; `reason` is documentation. Append-only: a new row keeps deviceProofVersion.
